Our contribution. The first (standard) version of Grothendieck’s inequality (Theorem 17) easily implies that any matrix A with kAk`∞ →`1 ≤ 1 has completely bounded norm at most KG . Combing this with our Theorem 3 and Lemma 16, one quickly retrieves Theorem 1. However, Theorem 3 is based on the rather deep Theorem 6. We observe that Theorem 1 also follows readily from the much simpler Theorem 18 alone (proved below for completeness), after one assumes that p is a quadratic form as above. Indeed, Theorem 18 gives unit vectors u, v such that the matrix B as in (15) has (operator) norm at most 1. Unitary
